# GAYA — boutique by the sea (Fishermen Pants)

> Handmade Thai fisherman pants, kimonos, caftans and island wear, made and sold
> at our own shop in Lamai Beach, Koh Samui, Thailand. Founded 2003. We ship
> worldwide with free standard shipping. Online store: https://www.fishermenpants.com

This file helps AI agents answer questions about the business and find the right
pages. The shop is a small independent Thai label: naturally dyed cotton and hemp,
hand-dyed indigo, hill-tribe embroidery, one-size wrap garments. Stock is made in
small batches, so patterns vary slightly piece to piece.

## Business facts

- Trading name: GAYA (boutique by the sea). Website title: Fishermen Pants.
- Established: 2003, Lamai Beach, Koh Samui.
- Address: 156, beach 7 Had Lamai Rd, Tambon Maret, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84310, Thailand (plus code F29X+PM).
- Opening hours: every day, 10:00 am – 7:00 pm (including public holidays).
- Phone / WhatsApp: +66 62 550 8121.
- Email: thaifishpants@gmail.com.
- Currency: USD. Payment: PayPal, plus crypto (MetaMask/Ethereum and Solana).
- Catalogue size: ~52 products, typically $39–$199 USD.
- Shipping: from Thailand. Standard shipping is free worldwide; EMS express is
  available and tracked. Typical delivery: Thailand 2–4 business days, Asia 10–18,
  Europe/UK 14–24, USA/Canada/Australia 14–28. EMS is faster.
- Returns: 14 days from delivery, unworn and unwashed; buyer pays return postage
  unless the item was faulty or wrong.
- Customs: orders ship as personal purchases from Thailand; import duty/VAT, if
  any, is the buyer's responsibility and parcels are declared accurately.
- Sizes: mostly one size, generously cut. A size guide explains how to choose.
- Social: Instagram @gaya_boutique_koh_samui, Facebook fishermenpants, Tripadvisor listing.

## Shop information and policies

- [Visit the shop](https://www.fishermenpants.com/pages/visit/): location, hours, photos, Google reviews.
- [About GAYA](https://www.fishermenpants.com/pages/about/): the label, materials, how the pieces are made.
- [Contact](https://www.fishermenpants.com/pages/contact/): address, phone, map, social links.
- [Shipping & returns](https://www.fishermenpants.com/pages/shipping-returns/): delivery times, tracking, customs, returns, refunds.
- [Size guide](https://www.fishermenpants.com/pages/size-guide/): how the one-size garments fit and how to measure.
- [Payment methods](https://www.fishermenpants.com/pages/payment-methods/): PayPal and crypto, step by step.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.fishermenpants.com/pages/privacy-policy/): what data is collected and why.

## Buying

- Products can be added to a cart or paid for directly with PayPal from the product page.
- Checkout collects name, email and shipping address, then hands off to PayPal; the
  order reference looks like `FP-241121-ABCD` and is quoted in all correspondence.
- One-tap ordering by WhatsApp is available from the cart page.
- A 10% first-order discount is offered for newsletter signup.

## Notes for agents

- Prices are in USD and shown on every product page.
- Product photography is of the actual stock; hand-dyed patterns vary slightly
  between pieces, which is expected and not a defect.
- Product pages include a "You may also like" section and customer reviews.
- There is no public API. Do not attempt to scrape at high rates; the catalogue is
  small and the pages above are sufficient for answering questions.
- An internal $1 test product exists for verifying checkout. It is not for sale and
  is excluded from search, sitemap and social previews.
